project.name: West Coast Hip-Hop Emotional Slow Build

arrangement.notes: Arrangement emphasizes a slow build of energy with minimal variations to enhance emotional delivery.

event_markers.label: Intro Start
event_markers.reason: Begin with minimal drum pattern using sample chop technique 'Slice Repeat'

event_markers.label: Verse 1 Bass Entry
event_markers.reason: Introduce bass line with sample chop 'Sliver Chop' for emotional slow build

event_markers.label: Hook Chords Variation
event_markers.reason: Add chords layer with 'Granular Chop' technique for mood lift

event_markers.label: Verse 2 Melody Variation
event_markers.reason: Melody constructed via 'Beat Repeat' sample chop to enrich emotional texture

event_markers.label: Final Hook Vocal Emphasis
event_markers.reason: Maximal vocal intensity supported by minimal samples processed by 'Time Stretch Chop'

event_markers.label: Outro FX Fade
event_markers.reason: Fade out FX using 'Reverse Chop' samples for smooth ending

sensei_drum.brief: Design minimal drum patterns using sample chop techniques such as 'Slice Repeat' to maintain slow build energy.

bass_generator.brief: Create bass lines using clean sample chop methods like 'Sliver Chop' matching emotional content.

harmony_generator.brief: Generate harmonic chord layers using granular sample chops to support mood and slow build energy profile.

melody_generator.brief: Develop subtle melodic elements employing beat repeat chopping techniques keeping the emotional tone intact.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement structure ensuring minimal variations within sections and consistent energy progression.

presetor.brief: Prepare sample chops for channels with names referencing chop techniques: 'Slice Repeat', 'Sliver Chop', 'Granular Chop', 'Beat Repeat', and 'Time Stretch Chop'.

songgps.brief: Maintain arrangement integrity adhering to slow build energy curve and minimal variation directive.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix unprocessed channel audio focusing on clarity and emotional mood enhancement.
